For fixed \(b,c,d\), the expression is linear in \(a\):
\[
a(2bcd-bc-bd-cd)-bcd.
\]
Since \(b,c,d\) are distinct positive odd numbers,
\[
\frac1b+\frac1c+\frac1d\le 1+\frac13+\frac15=\frac{23}{15}<2,
\]
so \(2bcd-bc-bd-cd=bcd(2-\frac1b-\frac1c-\frac1d)>0\). Thus the expression increases with \(a\). By symmetry, it increases in each variable.

So the minimum occurs at the smallest distinct positive odd numbers:
\[
(a,b,c,d)=(1,3,5,7).
\]
Then
\[
2(1)(3)(5)(7)-\bigl(1\cdot3\cdot5+1\cdot3\cdot7+1\cdot5\cdot7+3\cdot5\cdot7\bigr)
=210-(15+21+35+105)=34.
\]
\[
\boxed{34}
\]
